artboards.title: Text Expansion and Localization — button growth rules, script line-heights, currency/date/number formats

annotations.text: Prompt 52 — Text expansion, line-height variance and localization. Buttons grow, never truncate. Real Hindi/Tamil expansion samples. Devanagari +0.2 line-height, Telugu +0.25. Indian rupee lakh/crore formatting. Always Latin digits.
